case: EP-3 crisis, 2001: limited agreement and reserved disputes
classification_policy: Mixed record ledger: public demands, diplomatic instrument, acceptance, internal preparation, implementation and retrospective claims are explicitly distinguished. Internal guidance is not a bilateral offer; retrospective accounts are not independently observed moves. September 16 adds contemporary US reports of private exchanges; they remain unilateral records, and multiple observations from one encounter are not independent samples.
date_policy: Publication, recollection and intended action dates are separate. Exact date remains unknown where unestablished. Sun’s published timestamp does not establish the time of the oral briefing. April 11 authorization is not physical crew departure.
commitment_policy: Responsibility, reconnaissance, crew departure, aircraft inspection, disposition, technical execution and payment are separate objects. April 29 inspection is not aircraft return; acknowledging an agenda item is not accepting a substantive concession.

moves.record_type: contemporary public demand
moves.setting_channel_and_audience: Public statement directed to United States and domestic/international audiences
moves.issue_and_baseline: Collision responsibility, apology, reconnaissance, entry and immunity
moves.package_and_version: April 3 statement with five numbered positions; not bilateral agreed facts
moves.observed_move_or_state: Demands US responsibility, explanation, apology and prevention; advances factual and legal allegations.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Public MFA position established; original leadership instructions and fact-finding record absent.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: US public demand retains crew-plus-aircraft return; China later accepts narrower crew arrangement without relinquishing responsibility claims.

source_references.locator: Entire body, collision account and numbered positions 1–5

interpretation.proposed_mechanism: Link responsibility and relationship repair to crisis demands.
interpretation.strongest_rival: Sincere but inaccurate initial assessment or domestic public justification rather than calculated maximalist tactic.
interpretation.discriminating_evidence_needed: Dated instructions, initial reports and evidence of beliefs before public demands.

moves.confidence: high for statement, unresolved for beliefs and tactic

moves.record_type: contemporary public demand
moves.setting_channel_and_audience: Rose Garden, Washington; US and Chinese public audiences
moves.issue_and_baseline: Return of 24 crew and damaged aircraft
moves.observed_move_or_state: Calls for both crew and aircraft to return and warns of harm to bilateral relationship.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: President speaks publicly; actual mandate and conditional fallback options not acquired.

moves.confidence: high for public demand; unknown initial private fallback

moves.record_type: internal legal preparation, not a bilateral offer

moves.observed_move_or_state: Transmits legal papers combining sympathy for Chinese loss with preserved US legal positions; distinguishes crew/aircraft legal status while demanding aircraft release immediately.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Cover records consultation; informational memorandum, not presidential authorization or Chinese acceptance.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: Released April 11 letter combines sympathetic language with emergency context, but textual transmission from this packet is unproved.

interpretation.proposed_mechanism: Institutional preparation permits sympathetic expression without conceded responsibility.
interpretation.strongest_rival: Routine legal defense with no material effect on negotiation language.
interpretation.discriminating_evidence_needed: Draft circulation and decision records linking packet to actual proposed/accepted text.

moves.confidence: high for internal positions and consultation; causal role unresolved

source_references.locator: Physical p.9 / OSD1817 and p.14 / OSD1822

interpretation.proposed_mechanism: Audience-specific presentation can coexist with retained internal legal claims.

moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Government decision announced by foreign minister; internal release-order timing and deliberation not acquired.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: Further talks publicly announced April 18; aircraft disposition remains unresolved.

paras 5–13; Tang announces Chinese government decision and maintains responsibility claim; interpreter wording differs

moves.next_observable_response_or_state: April 18 talks continue on unresolved issues.

moves.confidence: High for published answers; exact time of speaking unestablished

moves.issue_and_baseline: Final delivery and US approval behind the letter

moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: MFA announces government position; original signed technical arrangement not acquired.

moves.record_type: Contemporary report of disputed conditions for release and consultation
moves.setting_channel_and_audience: Bilateral diplomatic meeting reported internally by the US government; subsequently publicly released
moves.observed_move_or_state: Tang requires explanation/apology before considering release, asserts Chinese evidence, invokes domestic reaction and questions the purpose of maritime consultations if the US denies the facts; Prueher contests the account and presses access/return.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Official statements made in the meeting; no original Chinese instruction or independently adjudicated collision account.
moves.interpretation_and_limit: Public opinion and facts may be bargaining arguments, sincere assessments, or both; the cable alone cannot distinguish motives.
moves.confidence: High for what the contemporary US report records; internal Chinese motives and approval process unresolved

moves.record_type: Contemporary report of drafting and clearance claims
moves.setting_channel_and_audience: Bilateral diplomatic meeting reported internally by the US government; subsequently publicly released
moves.observed_move_or_state: Zhou presents revisions described as high-level cleared. Prueher objects to less definite release/aircraft timing, consults Washington and delivers a new cleared US text at noon. A special envoy remains optional.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: High-level Chinese clearance is an attributed assurance; no full intermediate text or internal approval recovered.
moves.interpretation_and_limit: An approved opening response remains revisable; a negotiator cannot infer the final bargaining boundary from the clearance claim alone.
moves.confidence: High for what the contemporary US report records; internal Chinese motives and approval process unresolved

moves.record_type: Contemporary report of authority certification and selective revision
moves.actor: Zhou Wenzhong and Joseph Prueher, with Powell consulted
moves.setting_channel_and_audience: Bilateral diplomatic meeting reported internally by the US government; subsequently publicly released
moves.observed_move_or_state: After US declines an envoy, Zhou requests a Powell–Qian letter confirming Prueher’s authority. Prueher agrees, rejects apologize after consulting Powell, and supplies other revisions. Zhou says he will report and requires leadership package approval before departure details.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Separate authority letter arranged; actual full text and Chinese internal clearance absent. Consultation with military concerns follow-on agenda/delegation, not proof of a military veto over release.
moves.interpretation_and_limit: Coordination requirements are reported constraints, not independently proven reasons for delay.
moves.confidence: High for what the contemporary US report records; internal Chinese motives and approval process unresolved

moves.record_type: Contemporary report of another revision round
moves.setting_channel_and_audience: Bilateral diplomatic meeting reported internally by the US government; subsequently publicly released
moves.observed_move_or_state: Zhou seeks strengthened language including apologize, conveys objections to broader US pressure; Prueher warns existing wording may become harder to sustain. After consulting Powell, he accepts one unspecified minor change and rejects the rest. Zhou acknowledges improvement and promises a decision.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Both invoke superiors; actual leadership debate remains unrecovered. The minor wording change is not identifiable.
moves.interpretation_and_limit: The sequence establishes bounded movement, not which pressure or private judgment ultimately secured agreement.
moves.confidence: High for what the contemporary US report records; internal Chinese motives and approval process unresolved

moves.record_type: Contemporary report of effort to preserve one authorized bargaining channel
moves.setting_channel_and_audience: Bilateral diplomatic meeting reported internally by the US government; subsequently publicly released
moves.observed_move_or_state: Keith notes Chinese representations and declines further EP-3 argument in deference to Prueher, explicitly saying this should not imply acceptance of Chinese points.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: His stated handling of this encounter is observed; no claim all US officials followed it.
moves.interpretation_and_limit: Additional communication need not become an additional offer; its causal effect on agreement is unknown.
moves.confidence: High for what the contemporary US report records; internal Chinese motives and approval process unresolved

moves.record_type: Contemporary report of delivery, assurance and transfer drafting
moves.actor: US deputy chief of mission and James Moriarty; Lu Shumin and Zheng Zeguang
moves.setting_channel_and_audience: Bilateral diplomatic meeting reported internally by the US government; subsequently publicly released
moves.observed_move_or_state: US refuses advance signed copies, seeks specific release assurance and warns of no agreement without it. Zheng supplies prospective flight timing but not Tang’s exact words. The transfer memorandum changes despite an initial claim of no time: verbal is added to missing-clearance wording and thanks are removed.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Reported revisions and competing delivery rationales established; full memorandum versions and Chinese instructions remain absent.
moves.interpretation_and_limit: An asserted procedural deadline was not an immutable drafting limit; no Chinese intention to misuse signed copies is inferred.
moves.confidence: High for what the contemporary US report records; internal Chinese motives and approval process unresolved

moves.record_type: Contemporary report of an unaccepted return option
moves.observed_move_or_state: Prueher suggests assessment might favor flyout. Zhou calls it symbolically difficult but not the core issue; dates, plan and mode remain to be settled.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Qualified discussion is not flight permission; no claim this remained China’s view throughout May.
moves.confidence: High for the acquired US record; counterpart instructions and later May options remain incomplete

moves.record_type: Contemporary instruction and draft
moves.actor: Richard Armitage / State Department to Embassy Beijing
moves.observed_move_or_state: Authorizes discussion of a politically binding document under specified limits, excludes apology, wider compensation and a reconnaissance side agreement, and requires Washington approval before any signature commitment.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Actual US negotiation instruction acquired; approval to discuss is not approval to sign, and the return target is not an agreed deadline.
moves.confidence: High for the acquired US record; counterpart instructions and later May options remain incomplete

moves.record_type: Contemporary report and reproduced unilateral non-paper
moves.observed_move_or_state: China supplies its own record without requesting a US response and permits an assessment team despite incomplete US response to broader requests. The paper records disagreement on blame and differing payment positions.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: A Chinese non-paper and reproduced US proposal are not an executed joint text. Separate inspection permission does not authorize flyout.
moves.confidence: High for the acquired US record; counterpart instructions and later May options remain incomplete

moves.record_type: Contemporary report of revised practical arrangements and unresolved request
moves.actor: MFA officials, US defense attaché office and proposed assessment team
moves.observed_move_or_state: China accommodates an accompanying attaché officer and local discussion of extra working days while prohibiting flyout. After changing ministry responses to electrical power, a senior official proposes addressing the technical issue locally with PLA specialists; approval remains pending.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: No completed electrical-power permission, unrestricted repair approval or subsequent flight permission is established; reported lack of technical understanding does not prove the cause of every restriction.
moves.confidence: High for the acquired US record; counterpart instructions and later May options remain incomplete

new_propositions.claim: Separating immediate humanitarian action from attribution and policy questions may have made an otherwise unacceptable package feasible in this episode.
new_propositions.status: Mechanism hypothesis: structure observed, causation unproved.
new_propositions.supporting_test: A dated draft or instruction links the change in scope to acceptance.
new_propositions.disconfirming_or_weakening_test: Release was already authorized independently, or acceptance depended on a different concession.

new_propositions.claim: A channel’s informational value for resolution depends on whether reporting reaches and can be evaluated by the officials who authorize change.
new_propositions.status: Mechanism hypothesis: independent channel-effect record missing.
new_propositions.supporting_test: Trace a message into an assessment and resulting instruction.
new_propositions.disconfirming_or_weakening_test: The decision predates the message, the report was unused, or another channel provided the same information and caused the change.
